about: Spec 008 names table (T023), static part: the name the bench's rules give a call or a read path, with its proof by reference (N.js block, case, position, path, table name or bench tag; never game code). Game text may be in a name (Vinicius, 14/11). Converted from the bench's names-008 export (NAMES-008-static.json): names maps a call or a path, as the tree writes it, to [name, proof]. Then 54 calls the 007 catalog names from the game's own tables (proven at its index 0e47e87b, the same game as RULES_GAME_SHA), with the 007 proof by reference (Vinicius, 16/11). Then 2172 calls more the 007 catalog names and no earlier rule of the bench's nameOf does (the calls the app named keep their names, as do the blocks pieces.cjs nameOf names before the recording's row name), with the 007 proof by reference (spec 009 T029, Vinicius, 18/11: the bench is the reference of the names).
